description_expanded: Top Reasons Guests Love Last Call at NatureWalk 30A:* TWO 6-Seater Electric Golf Carts – cruise around with ease! (Drivers must be 21-Please note: a $500 refundable deposit is required.)* 6 Bikes – perfect for exploring trails and the neighborhood* 2 King Master Suites with Private Bathrooms* Beach Gear Galore – 12 chairs, 4 umbrellas, and beach toys included* Family-Friendly – 2 high chairs, 2 pack ’n’ plays, optional baby gates* Heated Outdoor Shower and Private Lawn with Adirondack Chairs* Quiet, Safe Neighborhood surrounded by scenic walking and biking trails* Access to “Gathering Place” – pools, hammocks, grills, and fire pit* Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support*This home is available only to adults 25 and older. No exceptions.Your perfect 30A getaway begins at Last Call at NatureWalk 30A, a beautiful 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home that sleeps up to 10 and is designed for families, friends, and multi-generational groups. Inside, enjoy oak wood floors, vaulted ceilings, and premium furnishings. The first floor offers an open living room with comfy seating and a flat-screen TV, a dining area for eight, a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances and marble countertops, plus a King master suite with ensuite. Upstairs, find a second King master, a Queen guest room, and a Full-over-Queen bunk room. Families will love the high chairs, pack ’n’ plays, beach toys, and optional baby gates, while adults can enjoy two 6-seater golf carts, six bikes, a private lawn, and a heated outdoor shower. Just a short walk to pools, trails, and the Gathering Place, this home combines comfort, fun, and convenience for an unforgettable 30A vacation.Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master Suite: King Bed2nd Floor:Master Suite: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedBunk Room: Full-over-Queen Bunk BedHOA rules: no boats, RVs, or trailers allowed.Lost or missing amenity passes are $150. Please leave the pass at home!-Community Amenities:-Zero-entry pool, heated lap pool, hot tub-Kiddie pool and playgrounds-Hammocks and outdoor lounge areas-Gas grills and fire pit-Volleyball, pickleball, basketball courtsLocation Highlights:Located just off Hwy 395, near WaterColor and Seaside, and surrounded by Point Washington State Forest, this home puts you in the heart of 30A adventure.-Private “Lilly Lane Beach Trail” – under a mile to Santa Clara Beach Access-Short golf cart ride to Seaside, WaterColor, or Grayton Beach-Trails, parks, kayaking, paddleboarding, and more right nearby30A is famous for its sugar-white sand, emerald waters, and endless activities:-Kayaking, biking, fishing, golfing, hiking, tennis, paragliding-WaterColor – pocket parks, Western Lake, butterfly gardens, boathouse fun, fine dining-Seaside – charming architecture, shops, restaurants, farmer’s market, cultural spotsSnorkeling:Check out the Sea Turtle Reef, just off Grayton Beach State Park. Perfect for families and snorkel enthusiasts (kayak or paddleboard recommended) Read less
